第二十八章威慑各方
在几个势力同守城兵发生冲突后，当天晚上所有的势力都在讨论着，关于陈林加税的问题，有的人认为是陈家的意思，所以陈林才会雷厉风行，也有人认为是陈林借陈家的势吓唬人。
不过这些势力都没有过早的下定论，而是看看陈林明天的反应伺机而动，也就是说陈林明天不能拿出足够的实力，那么他们就不会理会他。
而陈林现在则是将手下的所有的法师，都召集起来，选出五个四阶初级以上的中级法师，单独和他们谈了一短时间，就没有了任何动静。
当天晚上城中的一些势力，都通过不同的城主府内的眼线，知道了陈林手下只有一个七阶的高手，一时间这些势力对都准备明天看陈林出丑。
这一夜集镇城很安静，就连守城的官兵只是溜了一百名看守城，其他的士兵都全部休息，这让整个集镇城今晚上显得更加的寂静，今晚就像是暴风雨来临的前夜一般宁静。
想着天就是自己在异界组建根基的第一步，陈林走到窗外看着夜空明亮的月光说道“明天就让这些势力都知道，在基德镇到底是谁说了算。”
第二天，集镇城的普通人起来后，发现今天的集镇城显得比平时更加的安静，但却多了一份严峻的气氛，所有的普通人都感觉到了这份紧张感。
陈林却和平时一样，不紧不慢的吃过早饭，一旁的陈有财和张硕都等急了，他们不知道陈林下一步要怎么做，现在要是陈林拿不出足够的实力，震慑住城中的势力，那么加税的事情根本就实行不下去，而且陈林在基德镇的威望会降得很低。
见陈林吃完饭后，陈有财赶紧问道“少爷，今天是不是还要继续！”
陈有财心里现在很担心，昨天听陈林说每队分派一个七阶强者，以为陈林手下有陈家的高手相助，但是昨晚问过张硕后，才知道陈林根本就没有什么七阶高手。
陈林却很不在意的回答道“当然要继续了，让那些士兵都吃过早饭后，在城主府门口集合。”
“是”陈有财见陈林还是这么自信，顿时心里也有了地，下去准备集合士兵。
很快所有的人都集合好了，陈林看着下面已经集合好的一千多人，上前说道“都吃早饭了吗？”
所有人顿时一愣，都零零散散的回答道“吃过了！”
陈林接着问道“都吃饱了吗？”
这一次大家都有了准备，喊得比较整齐“吃饱了”
“吃饱了，声音tmd为什么这么小！”陈林这次是用了《太平要术》中记载的狮吼功！声音让所有的人都是一震“都给我大声点！”
“是”经过陈林这么一吼，所有的士兵都被惊醒。
“很好，你们都是陈家的兵，是我的兵。基德镇是我的领地，你们就是在自己的地盘上，都tmd给我精神点。让其他人看看，我的兵个个都是好汉！都准备好了吗？”陈林几句话就将自己的地位确立，而且成功的激励起士兵的气势。

这些并平时只是守城，维护治安平时都被其它势力的人看不起，现在陈林说是在自己的地盘上，一时间都感觉自豪无比，于是都用尽所有的力气吼道“准备好了！！！”
这一吼一千多人全力的呐喊，让整个集镇城都听的清清楚楚，只是这一吼就让所有的势力，不敢在小视陈林。
在将所有的士兵气势调动起来后，陈林接着说道“大家都知道今天要做什么吧！”
“知道！”又是一声齐吼！
“很好，就在昨天有些人竟然不将你们放在心眼里，看不起你们，就是看不起我陈林！今天每个小队都会分配一名七阶的亡灵法师，让那些看不起我们的人都看看，谁才是这里的主人！都拿出点气势！”
“是！！”听陈林这么说，此刻所有的人都疯狂了，他们知道自己翻身的时候到了。
“所有人和昨天一样，分成三小队每队三百人，每小队去一个交易市场。剩下的一百人跟着两名七阶高手，让昨天看不起我们的人付出代价！”说完陈林挥手，让身后的五名身穿黑色亡灵法袍人站出来。
一时间，下面一千多人都沸腾起来“万岁，万岁……”
“出发！”随着陈林一声，一千多人的队伍就带着滔天的气势出发！
当所有的人都走后，张硕走到陈林的旁边担忧的问道“少爷，这真的有用吗？”
“放心吧，他们手中都有我给的王牌，对付这些势力没有问题。”陈林很自信的说道。
其实陈林手下只有张硕一个七阶护卫，根本就没有什么七阶的高手，刚才那五人只是陈林昨晚挑选的中级法师。至于陈林的底牌是――魔法卷轴。
魔法卷轴是法师通过特殊的卷轴，将自己的法术储存起来，释放者只需要一点精神力，就可以施展卷轴上的魔法。理论上那怕是一阶的法师，只要有魔法卷轴就可以施展圣阶以下的所有魔法。
但魔法卷轴却很珍贵，因为制作工序繁琐成功率低，很幸运的是，亡灵召唤卷轴是最简单的魔法卷轴，唯一的代价就是需要牺牲一个亡灵生物。
不过这种牺牲对于陈林来说，跟本就不算数什么，陈林的亡灵手下何止千万，自从灵魂解封到五阶后，陈林已经可以召唤以前的亡灵生物了，只不过最高比自己高两阶的亡灵，也就是七阶巅峰。
陈林为了震慑各方势力，准备了足足十六张七阶的亡灵召唤卷轴，为了保密陈林利用禁魂咒收服了那五个中级法师，让他们利用召唤卷轴扮演一次七阶高手。
至于被发现的问题，陈林就更不用担心了，召唤卷轴虽然最容易制作，但却是最稀少的卷轴，因为其它卷轴只需要魔力，不论用多少都能恢复，但是召唤卷轴却是永远的失去亡灵生物，亡灵生物是亡灵法师的根本，没有哪个亡灵法师能像陈林这样。
每个家族每个势力都会有自己武装力量，陈林这次触及到他们的利益，这些势力肯定会用这些无礼抵抗，陈林自信的举动让很多势力都很忌惮，但是总有那么几个不信邪的站出来，很快三个小队都碰到了不同的阻碍！
就在他们以为陈林只是‘虚架子’的时候，队伍中身穿亡灵法袍的人，却直接召唤出了两只七阶高级的亡灵生物！几乎同时三个小队，中都出现了一名“七阶高级”的亡灵法师！
陈林的大手笔，让所有的势力都吃了一惊……

Chapter 28: Deterring All Parties
After several forces clashed with the city defenders, all the forces were discussing that night about Chen Lin's tax increase. Some people thought it was the Chen family's intention, so Chen Lin acted vigorously, while others thought it was Chen Lin using the Chen family's power to scare people.
However, these forces did not make premature conclusions, but waited for opportunities to see Chen Lin's reaction tomorrow. In other words, if Chen Lin could not show enough strength tomorrow, then they would ignore him.
Chen Lin now called together all the mages under his command, selected five intermediate mages of the fourth level and above, and talked with them alone for a short time, but there was no movement.
That night, some forces in the city learned through the spies in different city lords' palaces that Chen Lin only had a seventh-level master. For a while, these forces were ready to see Chen Lin make a fool of himself tomorrow.
The market town was very quiet that night. Even the officers and soldiers guarding the city only left a hundred to guard the city, and all other soldiers took a rest. This made the entire market town seem even quieter tonight. It was as quiet as the night before a storm.
Thinking that the sky was the first step for him to establish his foundation in another world, Chen Lin walked out the window and looked at the bright moonlight in the night sky and said, "Tomorrow, let these forces know who has the final say in Kidd Town."
The next day, when the ordinary people in Jizhen City got up, they found that Jizhen City seemed quieter than usual today, but it had a more serious atmosphere. All ordinary people felt this tension.
Chen Lin, as usual, ate breakfast leisurely. Chen Youcai and Zhang Shuo were waiting impatiently. They didn't know what Chen Lin was going to do next. If Chen Lin couldn't show enough strength to deter the forces in the city, the tax increase would not be implemented at all, and Chen Lin's prestige in Kidd Town would be very low.
After seeing Chen Lin finish his meal, Chen Youcai quickly asked, "Master, are we going to continue today?"
Chen Youcai is very worried now. Yesterday, he heard Chen Lin say that each team is assigned a seventh-level expert. He thought that Chen Lin had masters from the Chen family to help him. However, after asking Zhang Shuo last night, he found out that Chen Lin did not have any seventh-level masters at all.
Chen Lin replied nonchalantly, "Of course we have to continue. Let the soldiers gather at the gate of the city lord's mansion after breakfast."
"Yes." Seeing that Chen Lin was still so confident, Chen Youcai immediately felt confident and went down to gather the soldiers.
Soon everyone was gathered. Chen Lin looked at the more than a thousand people gathered below and stepped forward and said, "Have you all had breakfast?"
Everyone was stunned for a moment, and they all replied scatteredly, "I've eaten!"
Chen Lin then asked, "Are you all full?"
This time everyone was prepared and shouted "I'm full" more neatly.
"I'm full, why is my voice so low!" This time Chen Lin used the lion's roar technique recorded in "The Art of Taiping"! The sound shocked everyone and said, "Louder!"
"Yes" After Chen Lin shouted, all the soldiers were awakened.
"Very good, you are all soldiers of the Chen family, my soldiers. Kidd Town is my territory, and you are on your own territory. Give me some energy. Let others see that all my soldiers are heroes! Are you all ready?" Chen Lin established his status in a few words and successfully inspired the soldiers' momentum.
These are not just for defending the city. Maintaining law and order is usually looked down upon by people from other forces. Now that Chen Lin said that he was on his own territory, he felt extremely proud for a moment, so he used all his strength to shout "Ready!!!"
This roar, which was shouted by more than a thousand people with all their strength, could be heard clearly by the entire market town. Just this roar made all the forces dare not look down on Chen Lin.
After mobilizing the momentum of all the soldiers, Chen Lin continuedSaid "Everyone knows what we are going to do today!"
"I know!" Another roar!
"Very good. Just yesterday, some people didn't take you seriously. They looked down on you and looked down on me, Chen Lin! Today, each team will be assigned a seventh-level necromancer, so that those who look down on us can see who is the master here! Show some momentum!"
"Yes!!" Hearing what Chen Lin said, everyone was going crazy at this moment. They knew that it was time for them to stand up.
"Everyone is divided into three teams of 300 people each like yesterday. Each team goes to a trading market. The remaining 100 people will follow the two seventh-level masters to make those who looked down on us yesterday pay the price!" After saying this, Chen Lin waved his hand and asked the five people behind him wearing black undead robes to stand up.
For a time, more than a thousand people below were excited, "Long live, long live..."
"Let's go!" With Chen Lin's voice, a team of more than a thousand people set off with overwhelming momentum!
After everyone left, Zhang Shuo walked to Chen Lin and asked worriedly, "Master, is this really useful?"
"Don't worry, they all have the trump card I gave them, and they will have no problem dealing with these forces." Chen Lin said confidently.
In fact, Chen Lin only has Zhang Shuo, a seventh-level guard, and there are no seventh-level masters at all. The five people just now were just intermediate mages selected by Chen Lin last night. As for Chen Lin's trump card - the magic scroll.
Magic scrolls are where the mage stores his spells through special scrolls. The releaser only needs a little mental power to cast the magic on the scroll. Theoretically, even a first-level mage can cast all magic below the holy level as long as he has a magic scroll.
But magic scrolls are very precious, because the production process is cumbersome and the success rate is low. Fortunately, the undead summoning scroll is the simplest magic scroll, and the only price is to sacrifice an undead creature.
However, this kind of sacrifice is nothing to Chen Lin. Chen Lin has more than tens of millions of undead men. Since the soul was unsealed to the fifth level, Chen Lin can already summon the previous undead creatures, but the highest undead are two levels higher than himself, which is the peak of the seventh level.
In order to frighten all parties, Chen Lin prepared sixteen seventh-level undead summoning scrolls. In order to keep it secret, Chen Lin used the soul-forbidden spell to subdue the five intermediate mages and let them use the summoning scrolls to act as seventh-level masters.
As for the problem of being discovered, Chen Lin doesn't have to worry. Although the summoning scroll is the easiest to make, it is the rarest scroll, because other scrolls only require magic power and can be restored no matter how much it is used, but the summoning scroll permanently loses undead creatures. Undead creatures are the foundation of necromancers. No necromancers can be like Chen Lin.
Each family and each force will have its own armed forces. If Chen Lin touches their interests this time, these forces will definitely use these rude ways to resist. Chen Lin's confident behavior makes many forces jealous, but there are always a few who do not believe in evil and stand up. Soon the three teams encountered different obstacles!
Just when they thought Chen Lin was just showing off, the people in the team wearing undead robes directly summoned two seventh-level advanced undead creatures! Almost at the same time, a "seventh-level advanced" necromancer appeared in all three teams!
Chen Lin's generosity surprised all the forces...
